newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai expects 16 pct industry growth in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai expects 16 pct industry growth in 1996.

text.p: Shanghai's industrial production is expected to grow by 16 percent this year due to technical improvements and enterprise reforms, the official Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
The agency said the main factor behind the fast growth in production was improved marketing. It said Shanghai manufacturers now ran 20,000 sales offices nationwide.
Other factors contributing to the fast growth were expansion of the overall market in China and the ongoing reform of the state-owned enterprise sector, the agency said.
